subject.title: fix(auto-reply): hide recovered failed tool progress

question: Should this PR wait for current-head runtime or Telegram proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the older proof plus focused tests for this message-delivery change?
rationale: The code shape looks sound, but the proof is stale to a force-pushed head and the change suppresses user-visible progress, so accepting it without fresh proof is a maintainer risk call.

options.title: Wait For Current-Head Proof
options.body: Require proof on d34caeca43b56fad727ce89060ef63c0aa8f3cca showing hidden regular-verbose failed progress, delivered final reply, and preserved full-verbose diagnostics.

options.title: Accept Stale Proof And Tests
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the older runtime proof plus focused tests as sufficient for this narrow delivery-policy change.

options.title: Pause Until Proof Is Practical
options.body: Keep the PR open without repair work if current-head Telegram or runtime proof cannot be produced yet.

recommendation.title: Wait For Current-Head Proof
